title: 30E Ventures findings register entry
description: One entry per finding from 30E Ventures' own review of the Flashy estate's public packages. Deliberately narrow: enough for a stranger to check that a finding predates the fix that cites it (the Flashy estate's own 21 Nov 2026 proposal), and nothing a bad actor could use as a working reproducer. See findings/README.md.

id.description: Stable identifier, never reused or renumbered once published.

title.description: What the defect is, in one line - no exploit steps.

discovered.description: The date 30E Ventures actually found this, not the date it was published. Publishing late and dating honestly (see docs/decisions.md) is preferred over a false early date.

published.description: The date this entry went live at its public URL. null until it is.

severity.description: 30E Ventures' own rating. Never copy the affected party's rating without saying so.

summary.description: What the defect is and why it matters - never exploit steps, payloads, or working reproducer code. 'A reproducer exists' (reproducer_exists) is a fact; the reproducer itself is handed over privately if asked, never published here.

reproducer_exists.description: True if 30E Ventures holds a working reproducer for this finding, without publishing it.

fix_commit_url.description: The commit or PR that fixed it, once one exists and cites this finding's id - the discipline both sides agreed to (see docs/decisions.md). null until then.

note.description: Anything that does not fit the fields above - e.g. why status is 'disputed'.
